Neither timed entry retains a repetition backedge. Allocation, zeroing and the final checksum survive at demand/small_constant.o.s:366-377,394-422 and seq/small_constant.o.s:314-325,342-370; these are residual work, not the repeated hot work. The standalone wf_workload still contains empty counting loops at demand/small_constant.o.s:125-142, but they are absent from the timed entry.
